unit: Headless UI usability checks (accessibility deferred per D1)
notes: Headless smoke checks cover main-shell controls and Tab navigation, first-run acknowledgment focus, and visible About and MessageBox text. Screenshots and full semantic-tree captures in tests/screens/ are historical references only. AT-SPI and screen-reader accessibility remain deferred per D1. Adds behavioral coverage for narrow and wide library toolbar alignment, explicit editing, and synchronization of the quick-filter rail with the library.
